pages.text: $(l)Rats.$() Plague Rats come out in the dark and their bite often carries it.$(br2)$(l)Bad meat.$() Rotten flesh sometimes does.$(br2)$(l)The sick.$() Anyone with Fever or Buboes coughs it onto players and villagers standing close by. Keep your distance, or wear a mask. Later, $(l)Afflicted$() blows and $(l)miasma$() clouds carry it too.

pages.name: Plague Rat
pages.text: Fast and fragile. Terrified of cats. Its tail fetches a bounty from any Plague Doctor.
